references.text: Moses also blessed the people of Israel, showing a pattern where leaders bless the people before important transitions or farewells.
Joshua blessed Caleb before sending him off, a similar pattern of blessing at parting.
Joshua reminded the tribes that they could return to their tents and land once the mission was completed, which now happens in Joshua 22:6.
Moses' original agreement with Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh that they could return to their lands after the conquest.
Moses reminded the eastern tribes that they had to fight alongside their brothers before returning to their possessions.
Laban blessed his grandchildren and daughters before sending them off, a similar farewell pattern.
